description: `pipeline/crm-sync.js`: generic `upsertLead` mutation and local fallback return `synced:true`; HTTP 200 is accepted without inspecting GraphQL errors.
acceptance: Verify real pinned CRM schema, persist remote IDs, inspect response errors, maintain retry/conflict status. Failure/offline means not synchronized.

description: CLI imports `runPersonalizationBatch`, but module exports `personalizeBatch`.
acceptance: Fix import/call; prove the ESM CLI starts for every command. This static import can break the entire CLI before its switch executes.

description: CLI/package script mismatch: `import`, `seed`, `batch-status`, `template` are advertised without switch cases.
acceptance: Implement truthful supported commands; validation and nonzero exit codes; production seed prohibited. Test every package script.

description: UI qualification/verification cancel wrappers call non-batch `/cancel`; server only handles batch-scoped cancel. Batch-close wrapper also lacks a matching handler in the inspected server.
acceptance: Canonical API contracts and actual lifecycle endpoints; contract tests exercise UI calls against running handlers.

description: `js/api.js` replaces network/HTTP failure with empty/default success-shaped values.
acceptance: Explicit discriminated errors; UI distinguishes empty data, offline, unauthorized, partial, timeout, and successful zero counts.

description: `queueSends()` joins multiple personalizations and chooses their existing variant; it does not visibly consume `assignVariant()` or enforce campaign batch enrollment.
acceptance: Durable unique enrollment/step/variant assignment and campaign membership; one logical send per eligible enrollment/step.

description: Queue limits use already-sent counts, not atomic reservations; processor has no durable claim/recheck of pause, suppression, approval, or capacity at transmission.
acceptance: Atomic reservations/claims and a final serialized policy gate shared with stop/unsubscribe controls; concurrency/crash/race tests.

description: Queue writes ISO timestamps but compares with SQLite `datetime('now')`; pacing is reduced to a max 1.5-second sleep while config says 30–120 seconds; window settings are not enforced in that path.
acceptance: Canonical time types, timezone/DST-aware durable scheduler, real pacing/caps; tests for same-day due times and restarts.

description: `updateSend` writes `sent_at` for failed sends; runtime throws become `soft_bounce` regardless of cause.
acceptance: Separate attempted/accepted/sent/delivered/failed timestamps, auth/network/provider/DSN error taxonomy.

description: Compliance helper functions exist but the real send path sends a mailto unsubscribe header rather than using the HTTPS token/footer helpers.
acceptance: Apply verified current sender policy; tested MIME with real business identity/address and HTTPS one-click semantics.

description: Warm-up eligibility is inferred from elapsed days; calendar ramp is not evidence of actual warm-up activity or inbox placement.
acceptance: Separate scheduled volume ramp from measured warm-up/placement results. Require explicit policy and evidence; never synthesize received/opened/replied events.

description: `reply-tracker.js` stores message headers but attributes replies to latest send by address; interested reply changes status to `won`.
acceptance: Thread/mailbox/message references with fallback confidence; interested != opportunity won or meeting booked. Cancellation must not wait for AI.
